Redraw and examine one trial of an MRCT simulation

Source: R/mrct_case_study.R
mrct_case_study.Rd

Redraws trial k of a mrct_region_sims run exactly as the simulation drew it, runs forestsearch on its non-region patients (the region's patients as the test set) with the run's arguments and multiplier resampling, and analyses four patient sets: all patients, the region, region(\(G^*\)) (the region without the true harmed subgroup, when the trial has flag_harm) and region(\(\hat G\)) (the region without the declared subgroup \(\hat H\)).

Usage

mrct_case_study(
  dgm,
  seed,
  k,
  n = NULL,
  region_var = "z_regA",
  fs_args = list(),
  sim_args = list(rand_ratio = 1, draw_treatment = TRUE),
  analysis_time = 60,
  cens_adjust = 0,
  mr_inference = TRUE,
  mr_inference_args = list(ci_method = "field", include_complement = TRUE,
    field_complement = TRUE),
  entry_delay = NULL
)

Arguments

dgm

The DGM of the run (generate_aft_dgm_flex, inject_mrct_structure).

seed

The run's base seed (mrct_region_sims(seed = )).

k

The trial's index (sim).

n

The trial size (mrct_region_sims(n_sample = )); NULL (default) uses nrow(dgm$df_super), as mrct_region_sims() does.

region_var

The region indicator column. Default "z_regA".

fs_args

Named list of forestsearch() arguments. It may also hold the arguments that mrct_region_sims() takes directly (sg_focus, maxk, hr.threshold, hr.consistency, pconsistency.threshold, confounders.name, conf_force); those not given take mrct_region_sims()'s defaults, so a run's direct arguments and its fs_args together reproduce its identifier. The default confounders.name is that of mrct_region_sims(): for a mechanism built with a spline, it leaves out the three internal columns of the spline variable <var> by their exact names <var>_treat, <var>_k and <var>_k_treat; a covariate such as z_prior_treat and the region indicator stay. The data, the outcome, treatment, event, id and potential-outcome names, the display flags and the (sequential) parallel plan are set here, as in mrct_region_sims().

sim_args

Named list of simulate_from_dgm() arguments, as in mrct_region_sims(). Default list(rand_ratio = 1, draw_treatment = TRUE).

analysis_time

Calendar time of the analysis. Default 60.

cens_adjust

Censoring adjustment on the log scale. Default 0.

mr_inference

Logical. Run multiplier resampling on \(\hat H\) (fs_mr_inference). Default TRUE.

mr_inference_args

List passed to forestsearch(mr_inference_args = ); seed defaults to seed + k. Default: the field method with the complement de-biased and given its own field.

entry_delay

NULL (default) or list(var = <column>, delay = a), passed to simulate_from_dgm() (overrides sim_args$entry_delay).

Value

An object of class mrct_case_study, a list with

trial

The redrawn trial (data.frame).

fs

The forestsearch() result (its mr_inference element holds the MR result); mr_estimates_table(x$fs) gives the inference table.

sets

The four-set table: set, label, n, n_exp, n_ctl, events_exp, events_ctl, and the unadjusted two-sample Cox fit Surv(y_sim, event_sim) ~ treat_sim on the set: hr, lo, hi (Wald 95\ itt_all, itt_region, region_Gstar (when flag_harm exists) and region_Ghat (the whole region when nothing is declared).

in_Hhat

Logical, per trial row: membership of \(\hat H\) by get_dfpred on the selected definition.

confusion

When flag_harm exists, a list of two integer vectors c(TP, FP, FN, TN) of \(\hat H\) against \(H^*\) (flag_harm == 1), nonregion and region; else NULL.

Hhat

The definition as mrct_region_sims() records it ("none" when nothing is declared).

mr

fs$mr_inference.

trigger

Logical: all-patient upper limit < 1.0 and region hazard ratio > 1.0.

call_args

seed, k, n, region_var, analysis_time, the simulate_from_dgm() and forestsearch() argument lists (without data).

warnings

Warnings raised by forestsearch(), muffled and kept here.

Reproducing a simulated trial

mrct_region_sims() draws trial k in a worker with simulate_from_dgm(seed = seed + k), under the L'Ecuyer-CMRG generator that the workers run; mrct_case_study() switches to that generator for the draw (the same simulate_from_dgm() arguments: the sim_args defaults overridden by n, analysis_time, cens_adjust and seed + k, and entry_var = "entrytime" when dgm$df_super has that column) and restores the caller's generator, and the caller's random-number state, on exit. The identifier seeds its own random steps (data preparation and the consistency splits), so it returns the simulation's \(\hat H\) under any generator. Multiplier resampling runs after the draw under the caller's generator with seed = seed + k unless mr_inference_args gives a seed. (Inside mrct_region_sims() the resampling, if requested through fs_args, runs under the workers' generator, so its MR columns need not equal this object's.)

See also

mrct_select_case, mrct_region_sims, mr_estimates_table.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
k <- mrct_select_case(res)$sim
cs <- mrct_case_study(dgm, seed = 613800000, k = k, n = 1000,
                      region_var = "z_region",
                      fs_args = list(sg_focus = "hrMaxSG", maxk = 2,
                                     conf_force = character(0)),
                      sim_args = list(rand_ratio = 1, draw_treatment = TRUE,
                                      max_entry = 11),
                      analysis_time = 40, cens_adjust = 50)
cs
plot(cs)
mr_estimates_table(cs$fs)
} # }
